title.narrative: Strengthening Lung Health and Disability Inclusion through the Lung Organization in Burundi

description.narrative: The overarching purpose of this project is to improve the health, wellbeing, and quality of life of people living with chronic lung diseases (PLWLD) in Burundi particularly those whose conditions have resulted in disability. PLWLD face profound and intersecting challenges: stigma, social exclusion, limited access to quality care, and absence from health planning and policy dialogue. The project addresses these systemic barriers through three mutually reinforcing strategies: patient empowerment, health system strengthening, and evidence-based advocacy ensuring that patient voices inform decisions at both local and national levels. Central to the project is the institutional development of the BLA. By building BLA's governance structures, operational systems, and advocacy capacity, this project positions it as a credible national representative for PLWLD. The project also bridges NCD and disability advocacy forging structured collaboration between BLA, BNCDA, and NUDIPU to create a unified platform for joint advocacy, systemic policy reform, and inclusive health service delivery.
